notes.title: Demo Gameplay Update
notes.content:
Fixes[olist]
Fixed the issue where the Robot material displays abnormally under lighting conditions.

Added a rotation threshold limit for the heads of all objects that can gaze at the player.

Fixed the problem where teleporting enemies occasionally teleport to the opposite corridor, blocking the player from moving after they choose a door.

Fixed the bug in the DarkMover level where the player's perspective might fail to recover from the dark effect after choosing a door.

Fixed the issue where the rabbit in the WindowsRabbitHead event had no sound effects.

Fixed the problem where the original robots remained in the Wellcome level.

Fixed the issue where the door used to cover flaws in TruthTwo was not hidden.

Fixed the unlocalized audio issue of "Dad found me" in TruthOne.

Resolved the clipping problem caused by the disappearance of space when the player enters the door backward in the corridor.

Resolved the issue where quitting the game directly without clicking the Return button at the end would result in entering the third loop upon re-entry.

Resolved the issue where the progress was not reset when quickly clicking return after dying and entering the death room.
[/olist]Updates[olist]
Adjusted the difficulty of the OneTwoThree level.

Reduced the difficulty of the InvisibleFollower level.

Modified the material appearance of DarkMover to distinguish it from other types of robots.

Adjusted the material of ordinary robots (the original material was too dark).

Optimized the RedLightGreenLight level:

Added sound effect prompts for light switching;

Slightly increased the robot's start-up delay;

Reduced the level difficulty.

Adjusted the door opening logic: the player's view will automatically align forward, and it is no longer required to "look at the door" to unlock it.

Extended the light flickering time and reduced the difficulty of the DarkMover level.
[/olist]

notes.title: Demo Gameplay Update
notes.content:
Fixes:
Fixed the bug in the ChooseDoor level where the door required repeated triggering to open due to issues with the player's 视野判定 (field of view detection).

Fixed the issue in linear levels where the door would disappear if the player quickly turned back after opening it, causing a continuity error.

Adjusted the reaction force of the body bag on the player in BodyBag to make it easier for the player to pass through.

Fixed the issue where the light-off effect sometimes failed in DarkMover.

Fixed the bug in the Cameras level where the sound never faded.
Updates:
Adjusted the amplitude and frequency of camera shake, and modified the maximum acceleration of character movement to make the character's actions slightly clumsier.

Added a highlight display for the current progress in the progress panel.

Updated the score panel to show total depth, changing from the original "1" to "1/3".

Adjusted the frequency band of UI sound effects, weakened the high-frequency part, and added a warning sound effect for UI pop-ups.

After the player chooses a door, there will be clear sound prompts (correct/incorrect).

Adjusted the level order, placing more difficult levels in the second loop.

Increased the volume of the Eyes event to make anomalies easier to detect.

Updated some levels with relatively hidden anomalies to make them easier to find.

Added localized content for the rabbit doll's voice.

Added a light refraction material to invisible enemies to improve their visibility.

Slightly adjusted the layout of the loop space to place the prompt panel.
Additions:
Added an opening prompt: "Wearing headphones for a better experience".

Added a hint system that will provide prompts when the player makes repeated mistakes in a certain level.

Added warnings for players with heart disease or hypertension.

Added a "boredom button" during compilation.

Added a manual panel next to the progress panel to clarify the game rules.
